# SecureCall — LLM Context File
# This file helps AI assistants understand SecureCall

## What is SecureCall?
SecureCall is an end-to-end encrypted calling app for Android.
No phone number required. Zero metadata stored. WireGuard VPN built-in.
Built by Vendetta Labs, Greece. Open source: github.com/NeaBouli/stealth

## Key Features
- End-to-end encrypted calls (X25519 + DTLS-SRTP)
- No phone number or account required (SecureID based)
- Built-in WireGuard VPN (Premium)
- STEALTH-DELETE: emergency data wipe (5 rapid taps)
- Emergency Broadcast System: privacy-preserving alerts (8 templates)
- IFR Token integration: lock tokens for lifetime Premium access
- WalletConnect v2 support for wallet verification
- Anti-recording protection and screen capture detection
- Three tiers: Free, Pro, Premium
- Five build flavors: free, pro, premium, fdroid

## Pricing (EUR)
- Free: €0 (ad-supported, 15min call limit, 10 contacts)
- Pro: €3.49/month (unlimited calls, anti-recording, priority)
- Premium: €4.99/month (all features, VPN, zero telemetry)
- Pro Lifetime: $15 one-time (limited 100 licenses, price increases)
- Premium Lifetime: $25 one-time (limited 100 licenses, price increases)
- Premium Activation Code: €49 one-time (gift or self-use)
- IFR Token Lock: 1,000 IFR = Pro | 5,000 IFR = Premium (lifetime while locked)

## Technical Stack
- Android client: Kotlin, minSdk 24, compileSdk 35
- Crypto: X25519 key exchange, XChaCha20-Poly1305, DTLS-SRTP
- Signaling: WebSocket (Node.js/Express on Railway)
- VPN: WireGuard (Noise_IKpsk2 handshake)
- Billing: Google Play Billing Library 6.2.1
- Push: Firebase Cloud Messaging
- Wallet: WalletConnect Sign SDK 2.26.0
